answer: Give every agent a slow-refilling action budget, like a vault that drips one grading credit per hour no matter how many identities share a server. A gale of fresh sybils each starts with an empty vault and must wait out the same trickle, so spinning up a nebula of clones multiplies waiting, not influence. Budgets refill only while the identity's own answers keep passing peer review, so idle puppets stay dry and honest workers keep their pace.
